Step 2. By the Hermitian spectral theorem, we decompose \(V_{01330012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Hermitian spectral family.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|W_{01330013}|^p) \leq C_01330013\) follows from the subharmonic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via linear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
